Generator.summary: You carry a steady, renewable life force. When you spend it on work and people that genuinely light you up, you can keep going for a long time. Your power is in responding: let life bring you something, then listen to your gut before you commit.
Generator.aura: Your aura is open and enveloping. It wraps around people and things, and it lets life know you are available. That is why things come to you: questions, offers, invitations, problems to solve. You do not have to go looking. Your job is to notice what has already arrived and check it with your gut.
Generator.experiment: For a while, start nothing from your head. Wait for something to respond to, check your gut, and notice how much more energy you have for the things you said yes to.
Generator.strat: Waiting to respond is not sitting still. It means letting something outside you start the conversation: a message, an idea someone mentions, a job post you stumble on, a question. Then your Sacral answers, often as a sound before a thought. A yes from the gut means you have the energy for it. A no means you do not, however good it looks on paper. The trouble starts when you start things from your head, because the head can commit you to things your body has no energy for.
Generator.signs: Satisfaction is your signal that you are on track: the tired-but-good feeling at the end of a day spent on the right things. Frustration is the alarm. It shows up when you are stuck in work you never really responded to, or when you are trying to force progress. Frustration is not failure, it is information: something is not yours, or the timing is off.
Generator.work: You are built to work, and to work for a long time, as long as the work lights you up. When your energy goes into something you genuinely responded to, you build mastery step by step, and the plateaus are part of it: long flat stretches, then a sudden jump. Money follows energy that is used correctly. If you dread Monday, that is not laziness. It is your Sacral telling you this is the wrong use of your life force.
Generator.love: Your gut knows who you are drawn to, and it often knows before you do. Let the other person make the move or ask the question, then listen to your response. Watch the pattern of saying yes from guilt or habit: a relationship you did not respond to will drain you, however kind the person is.
Generator.rest: Go to bed tired. Your Sacral energy needs to be used up each day so you can sleep deeply and wake renewed. If you go to bed with energy left, you lie awake. Move your body, do the thing you love, and let yourself stop when the energy is genuinely done.

Manifesting Generator.summary: You have Generator energy with speed. You are multi-passionate, you skip steps, and you often find the shortcut nobody else saw. Respond first, then tell the people your choice affects before you leap.
Manifesting Generator.aura: Your aura is open and enveloping, like a Generator's, with a burst of speed built in. People feel your energy and your momentum. Life brings you a lot, and you can respond to several things at once.
Manifesting Generator.experiment: Before your next leap, check two things: did my gut respond to this, and did I tell the people it affects? Notice how much smoother the jump goes.
Manifesting Generator.strat: Respond first, then inform. Your Sacral still leads: wait for something to respond to, check your gut, and only then move, often fast. Before you leap, tell the people your move will affect. A quick heads-up saves you most of the resistance and the "why didn't you tell me" moments. Skipping steps is natural for you. Just go back and check what you skipped, because sometimes something important is in there.
Manifesting Generator.signs: Satisfaction tells you that your energy is going to the right places. Frustration shows up when things move too slowly or when you are in something you never responded to. Anger often appears when people try to slow you down or when you forgot to inform them. Both are signals, not character flaws.
Manifesting Generator.work: You are multi-passionate by design. Several projects, a career that changes direction, jumping between interests: none of this is a lack of focus, it is how you work. You find the shortcut nobody else saw. Your best work comes when you follow your gut responses rather than a five-year plan, and when you are allowed to drop what no longer lights you up without guilt.
Manifesting Generator.love: Your gut answers quickly, sometimes in seconds. Let the other person initiate, respond honestly, then talk about what you are about to do. Partners who need you to slow down to their pace may frustrate you. Partners who give you room to move fast and change your mind tend to suit you.
Manifesting Generator.rest: Like Generators, you sleep best when you go to bed with your energy used up. Move your body daily. Burnout comes from saying yes to everything, not from doing a lot.

Projector.summary: You are not here to keep up with everyone else’s output. You are here to see people and systems clearly, and to guide them. Your insight lands best when you are recognised and invited, especially for the big things: work, love, and where you live.
Projector.aura: Your aura is focused and absorbing. It goes straight to the core of one person at a time and takes them in. That is how you see what others miss: the real dynamics in a team, what your friend actually wants, where a system is wasting energy. It is also why unsolicited advice can land badly. When someone has not invited you in, your focus can feel like a penetration rather than a gift.
Projector.experiment: Notice every time you offer advice nobody asked for, and how it lands. Then try waiting until someone asks, and feel the difference in how your words are received.
Projector.strat: Wait for the invitation, especially for the big things: work, love, where you live, who you share your life with. An invitation is when someone recognises you and asks: "What do you think?", "Would you work with us?", "Will you help me with this?" Day to day you can still act, create and offer things, but the big moves go best when someone has seen you first. Waiting is not passive: study what fascinates you, master a system, and let your expertise become visible.
Projector.signs: Success is your signal: being recognised, your guidance landing, things going well with less effort. Bitterness is the alarm. It shows up when you push without being invited, when you work like a Generator to prove yourself, or when you give and give without being seen. Bitterness is useful: it shows exactly where you are not recognised.
Projector.work: You are not built for long fixed hours of steady output. You do not have a defined Sacral, so you borrow work energy from people around you, and borrowed energy runs out. Your value is in seeing, guiding and managing energy: a few focused hours can be worth more than someone else's full day. Price for insight, not time. Choose work where you are recognised and invited, and protect your rest as part of the job.
Projector.love: Be invited into love. When someone genuinely recognises who you are and asks you in, the relationship holds your energy well. If you chase or convince, you often end up feeling unseen. Your focused aura is intimate by nature, so time alone to come back to yourself is not a rejection of your partner, it is how you stay clear.
Projector.rest: Rest before you are exhausted. Lie down before you are tired, ideally alone, to discharge the energy you absorbed from other people. Many Projectors sleep better when they get into bed before they feel sleepy. Rest is not a reward for working hard enough. It is part of how you are built.

Manifestor.summary: You are built to start things and set them in motion. You do not need permission, but a quick heads-up to the people your actions affect removes most of the resistance you meet.
Manifestor.aura: Your aura is closed and repelling. It keeps your energy contained so you can initiate without being pulled into other people's plans. People feel your presence before you say a word, and they often cannot read what you are about to do. That unpredictability is what makes informing so important.
Manifestor.experiment: Before each big move this month, tell the people it will affect, in one sentence. Not to ask permission. Just to inform. Notice the resistance melt.
Manifestor.strat: Inform before you act. You do not need permission. You do need to tell the people your action affects, before you do it: "I'm moving out in March," "I'm starting this project," "I need the evening to myself." Informing is not asking. It simply removes the resistance that comes from people being caught off guard, and it opens the way for you.
Manifestor.signs: Peace is your signal: a quiet inside, being left free to do what you came to do. Anger is the alarm. It rises when people control, block or interrupt you, and it often rises because they were not informed. Anger is information that something, or someone, is in your way.
Manifestor.work: You are built to start things and set them in motion, then often hand them over for others to build. Your energy comes in bursts, not steady shifts, so a rigid nine to five can feel like a cage. You do your best work when you have autonomy, when you can act on your urges, and when the people around you know what you are about to do.
Manifestor.love: You need freedom inside a relationship, and partners who do not try to control you. Informing works in love too: let your partner know when you need space, when you are leaving early, what you are planning. It turns your independence into something they can trust rather than something that surprises them.
Manifestor.rest: Your energy comes in bursts, then you need real downtime. Lie down before you are exhausted, and let yourself rest without guilt after a burst of initiating. You are not lazy between bursts, you are recharging.

Reflector.summary: You are rare and deeply sensitive to your surroundings. You reflect the health of the people and places around you. Big decisions deserve time: about a month, talked through with people you trust.
Reflector.aura: Your aura is resistant and sampling. It samples the energy of the people and places around you without being taken over by it. You reflect back the health of your environment: when the place and the people are well, you shine; when they are not, you feel it first. You are a living barometer.
Reflector.experiment: Pick one decision you are facing and give it a full lunar cycle. Write down how it feels on a few different days, and notice what is still true at the end.
Reflector.strat: Wait about a lunar cycle, roughly 28 days, before big decisions. The Moon moves through all 64 gates in that time, so you experience the decision through every part of your chart. Talk it through with a few trusted people along the way, not for their advice, but to hear how it sounds to you on different days. Small daily decisions do not need a month.
Reflector.signs: Surprise is your signal: life delighting you, people surprising you in good ways. Disappointment is the alarm. It often shows up when you are in the wrong environment or among people who do not suit you, or when you made a big decision too fast.
Reflector.work: You are rare, about 1% of people, and you do not have a consistent way of working, because nothing in your chart is fixed. That is your gift: you can sense what a team or a community needs, and you notice when something is off before anyone else. The environment is everything for you. Choose your workplace like your health depends on it, because in a way it does.
Reflector.love: You take in the person you are with very deeply. Choose people whose energy you genuinely enjoy reflecting. Give big relationship decisions, such as moving in or marrying, the full lunar cycle. Time apart helps you remember who you are without the other person's energy.
Reflector.rest: Sleep alone when you can, or at least in your own space, so you can let go of the energy you took in during the day. Time in nature and in places that feel good to you is not a luxury. It is how you come back to yourself.

Emotional.summary: Your clarity comes in waves. You are not built to decide in the heat of a high or the weight of a low. Give important choices time, sometimes a few nights, until the answer feels calm and steady. There is no truth in the now for you.
Emotional.feel: Your Solar Plexus is defined, so you live on an emotional wave: hope and doubt, excitement and flatness, moving in their own rhythm. The wave is not a problem to solve. It is how clarity reaches you, over time.
Emotional.scene: You get a job offer and feel a rush: yes, this is it. Two days later it looks risky. A few days after that it feels simply right, or simply wrong, and that feeling stays put. That calm, settled feeling, after you have ridden the highs and lows, is your answer.
Emotional.trap: Deciding at the top of the wave (the excited yes you later regret) or the bottom (the "forget it" you later miss). People who push for an answer now. The belief that a quick decision is a good one.
Emotional.practice: Say "let me sleep on it" as your default for anything important. For bigger decisions, give it several nights. Notice the shape of your own wave. There is no truth in the now for you, and that is not indecision. It is accuracy.

Sacral.summary: Your gut speaks in the moment, often as a sound: an “uh-huh” or an “uh-uh”. It is honest and immediate. Questions help it speak, so let people you trust ask you simple yes or no questions.
Sacral.feel: Your gut responds in the moment, often as a sound or a pull in your body before your head has an opinion. "Uh-huh" means yes, there is energy for this. "Uh-uh" means no. It is honest and immediate, and it only works in response to something.
Sacral.scene: A friend asks, "Do you want to come to the beach on Saturday?" Before you think about the traffic or what you should do, something in your belly lifts or drops. That first response is your authority.
Sacral.trap: Open questions like "What do you want to do with your life?", which your gut cannot answer. Overriding the response with logic, guilt or politeness. Starting things from your head without anything to respond to.
Sacral.practice: Ask the people close to you to ask you yes or no questions when you are stuck. Listen for the sounds you make. Notice how a decision made from your gut feels a week later compared to one made from your head.

Splenic.summary: Your knowing is quiet, instant and speaks only once. It is an intuitive hit about what is safe and healthy for you, right now. Trust the first whisper. It will not repeat itself.
Splenic.feel: Your Spleen is your authority: a quiet, instant knowing about what is safe and healthy for you, right now. It speaks once, softly, in the moment, and does not repeat itself.
Splenic.scene: You walk into an apartment viewing and something in you says "no" before you have seen the kitchen. Your mind starts listing all the reasons it is perfect. The whisper was the answer.
Splenic.trap: Waiting for the instinct to come back louder (it will not). Overriding it with your mind because you cannot explain it. Fear of what others will think if you act on a feeling you cannot justify.
Splenic.practice: Notice the very first impression, and act on it in the moment where you can. Keep a small note of times you ignored your instinct and what happened. Trust grows as you see how often it was right.

Ego Manifested.summary: Your truth comes from your heart’s will: what you genuinely want and are willing to commit to. Listen for what comes out of your mouth when you speak from the heart, and ask yourself, “Do I actually want this?”
Ego Manifested.feel: Your Heart (Ego) centre is your authority, connected to your Throat. Your truth comes out in what you say you want, in the moment, from your heart. Will and desire lead.
Ego Manifested.scene: Someone asks if you want to take on a project and you hear yourself say "Yes, I want that" or "No, I don't want to." That spoken heart-level want is the decision.
Ego Manifested.trap: Promising things you do not genuinely want, to please people. Ignoring your own wants because wanting feels selfish.
Ego Manifested.practice: Ask yourself plainly: "Do I want this? What's in it for me?" It is not selfish, it is your design. Keep only the promises your heart truly wants to keep.

Ego Projected.summary: Your truth comes from your heart’s will: what you genuinely want and are willing to commit to. Talk it through and ask yourself, “What’s in this for me? Do I truly want it?”
Ego Projected.feel: Your Heart (Ego) centre is your authority, connected to your G centre. Your truth comes through what your heart wants, heard when you talk it through.
Ego Projected.scene: You are offered a role. You talk it through with a friend, and you hear yourself say, "Honestly, I want this, and here's what I'd get from it," or you hear yourself make excuses. What your heart wants becomes clear as you speak.
Ego Projected.trap: Committing to things your will does not want, to prove your worth. Talking to people who give advice instead of letting you hear yourself.
Ego Projected.practice: Ask "What's in this for me? Do I really want it?" out loud, with someone who just listens. Only commit when the want is real.

Self-Projected.summary: You find your truth by hearing yourself speak. Talk your decisions through with people you trust, not for their advice, but to hear what your own voice says. Your sense of direction leads the way.
Self-Projected.feel: Your G centre connects to your Throat, so your truth comes through hearing yourself speak. Your identity and direction speak through your voice. You do not find clarity by thinking silently. You find it by talking.
Self-Projected.scene: You are deciding whether to move cities. You call a friend and say, "I'm not asking for advice, just let me talk." Twenty minutes later you hear yourself say something with total certainty that you did not know you believed. That is your answer.
Self-Projected.trap: Asking for opinions and then following them. Deciding in your head. Talking to people who interrupt or try to fix it.
Self-Projected.practice: Choose two or three sounding boards who are good at just listening. Voice notes to yourself work too. Listen for the sentences that come out clear and calm, and the ones that feel like "yes, that's me."

Mental.summary: Your clarity comes from talking things through in the right environment, with the right people. Use trusted sounding boards and notice how different places feel. Your mind is for reflecting, not for deciding.
Mental.feel: You have no inner authority below the Throat. Your Head, Ajna and Throat may be defined, but your mind is not your decision maker. Clarity comes from talking things through in the right environment, with the right people, and hearing yourself.
Mental.scene: You are choosing between two jobs. You talk it through with a trusted friend in one place, then again with another person in a different place. You notice where you feel at ease, and what you keep saying. Over time, the answer becomes obvious.
Mental.trap: Deciding in your head and calling it clarity. Staying in places that do not feel right. Rushing.
Mental.practice: Take your time. Change environments when deciding. Use several trusted sounding boards. Notice how different places feel in your body, because the right environment is part of your decision.

Lunar.summary: Your clarity comes over a full moon cycle, about 28 days. Let big decisions breathe, talk them through, and notice how they feel as you move through different moods and places.
Lunar.feel: As a Reflector, your clarity comes over a full lunar cycle, about 28 days, as the Moon moves through all 64 gates and you experience the decision from every angle.
Lunar.scene: You are considering a big move. Over a month you talk about it with a few trusted people, in different moods and places. Some days it feels exciting, some days not. By the end of the cycle, you just know, and it is often a pleasant surprise.
Lunar.trap: Being rushed into big decisions. Taking on other people's certainty as your own.
Lunar.practice: Track the Moon for a few months to see how your energy shifts. Give big decisions the full cycle. Keep small daily choices light.

profiles.1/3: The Investigator / Martyr. You need solid foundations, so you research until you feel secure, and then you test what you have learned by living it, bumping into things and discovering what does not work. Your life is a mix of study and trial and error. Nothing is a failure for you, it is data. Over time you become the one who knows what actually works, because you have checked it from both ends.
profiles.1/4: The Investigator / Opportunist. You build a deep foundation of knowledge and then share it through your network. Your opportunities come through people you already know, and your authority comes from having done your homework. Friendships matter enormously: they are how your life moves. You feel safest when you are both well informed and well connected.
profiles.2/4: The Hermit / Opportunist. You have natural gifts that others see before you do, and you need real time alone to let them grow. Then your network calls you out: friends, colleagues, people who already know you. You do not need to chase opportunities. They come through your people. Protect your alone time, and be open when the right people call your name.
profiles.2/5: The Hermit / Heretic. You need lots of time to yourself, and you have natural gifts that people project onto: they see you as the one with the answer. When you are called out and offer a practical solution, your reputation grows. When the projection does not fit, people can turn quickly. Choose carefully what you step forward for.
profiles.3/5: The Martyr / Heretic. You learn by experimenting, trying, breaking things and finding out. People project onto you that you can fix their problems, and your trial-and-error life gives you exactly the practical wisdom they need. Your path is full of bonds made and broken, jobs tried and left. That is not instability. It is research.
profiles.3/6: The Martyr / Role Model. You spend roughly the first thirty years experimenting and learning through experience, then step back to observe and heal, and later live what you know as a model for others. The messy early years are not wasted. They are the education that makes you wise.
profiles.4/6: The Opportunist / Role Model. Your life moves through your network, and your foundation is friendship. Your life unfolds in phases: experimenting when young, a period of stepping back to watch from the roof, then becoming an example for others. People trust you because they know you.
profiles.4/1: The Opportunist / Investigator. This profile is rare and fixed: a single, specific path walked steadily. Your solid foundation of knowledge meets your network, and you do not bend to fit others. You are most yourself when you stay true to what you know, and share it with the people who already trust you.
profiles.5/1: The Heretic / Investigator. People project onto you that you have the answer, the practical solution. Behind it is serious research and a solid foundation. When your solutions work, your reputation soars. Protect your reputation by stepping forward only when you truly know, and step back when the projection does not fit.
profiles.5/2: The Heretic / Hermit. People see you as the one who can save the day, and you have natural gifts that you may not even recognise. You need time alone, and you are called out to offer practical solutions. Choose when to answer the call: your reputation depends on stepping forward only when the solution is truly yours to give.
profiles.6/2: The Role Model / Hermit. Your life moves in three phases: experimenting until about thirty, stepping back to observe and heal until about fifty, and then living what you know as a natural example. Your hermit side needs time alone, and your gifts are seen by others before you see them. Trust the slow unfolding.
profiles.6/3: The Role Model / Martyr. Your life combines deep experimentation, lots of trial and error, with the long arc of the role model. The early years are full of discovery and bumps. Later, you become a wise and honest example, precisely because you have lived it all and you do not pretend otherwise.

definitions.No Definition: You have no definition: all nine centres are open. That is the Reflector design. You sample and reflect everything around you, and your consistency comes from the Moon's cycle rather than from your own chart.
definitions.Single Definition: You have single definition: all your defined centres connect in one continuous flow. You process things internally and in your own way, and you rarely feel that something is missing. You can be quite self-contained, and you may need to remember that others work differently.
definitions.Split Definition: You have split definition: your defined centres form two separate areas that do not connect inside your own chart. You may feel there is a gap, and you are drawn to people whose gates bridge it. When the bridge is there, you feel whole. Be careful not to choose people only because they complete you, and give yourself time to process alone, so your own energy can come together.
definitions.Triple Split Definition: You have triple split definition: three separate areas of definition. You process through many people and places rather than one person. Being out in the world, in public spaces and among different people, helps all of you come online. You need time and a variety of company to reach clarity.
definitions.Quadruple Split Definition: You have quadruple split definition, which is very rare: four separate areas. You are fixed and steady in your own way, and you take time to process. Do not rush yourself. Different people bring different parts of you online.

Head.does: Pressure to think, inspiration, and the questions you carry.
Head.defined: You have a consistent kind of inspiration and a steady set of questions you keep returning to. Your mental pressure is reliable. It is a gift for others, who can be inspired by your questions, as long as you remember the pressure to know is yours, not theirs.
Head.open: You take in other people's questions and mental pressure and amplify them. You can be wonderfully open-minded and inspired by many different things.
Head.question: Am I thinking about things that don't matter to me?
Head.trap: Trying to answer every question that passes through you, including questions that have nothing to do with your life. Feeling pressure to figure things out right now.
Head.wisdom: Over time you learn which inspiration is actually worth your attention. You become wise about what is worth thinking about.

Ajna.defined: You process information in a fixed, reliable way. People can count on how you think. Your opinions and concepts are consistent, which is a gift, as long as you remember others are not built to think like you.
Ajna.open: You can see many perspectives at once and you do not have one fixed way of thinking. That makes you open, flexible and genuinely curious.
Ajna.question: Am I trying to convince everyone that I am certain?
Ajna.trap: Pretending to be certain. Holding on to opinions just to sound sure. Feeling stupid because your thinking changes.
Ajna.wisdom: You become wise about the many ways of seeing things, and you do not need to be certain to be smart.

Throat.does: Expression, communication and manifestation: turning energy into words and action.
Throat.defined: You have a consistent way of expressing yourself and of getting things done through your voice. People recognise how you speak.
Throat.open: You can speak in many voices and adapt to every room. Words come best when the moment is right and when you are invited to speak.
Throat.question: Am I trying to attract attention?
Throat.trap: Talking to fill silence. Speaking to get attention. Forcing words out because you feel unseen.
Throat.wisdom: You become wise about who is speaking the truth, and about when something genuinely needs saying.

G.does: Identity, love and direction: who you are and where you are going.
G.defined: You have a fixed sense of who you are and a steady direction, even if you could not put it into words. People can orient themselves around you.
G.open: Your sense of identity and direction is fluid, shaped by the places and people around you. You can be many different versions of yourself.
G.question: Am I still looking for love and direction?
G.trap: Searching for love and direction everywhere. Staying in places or relationships that do not feel right because you are afraid to lose yourself.
G.wisdom: The right place brings you the right people and the right direction. You become wise about what makes a place or a person good.

Heart.does: Willpower, self-worth, promises and the material world.
Heart.defined: You have consistent willpower. When you truly want something and commit, you can follow through. Rest after you make it happen. Keep only the promises your heart wants to keep.
Heart.open: You do not have fixed willpower, and you have nothing to prove. Your worth is not up for negotiation.
Heart.question: Am I trying to prove my worth?
Heart.trap: Proving yourself. Overpromising. Comparing your worth. Pushing through on willpower you do not consistently have.
Heart.wisdom: You become wise about what is genuinely worth something, and you can see when other people are running on ego.

Spleen.does: Instinct, health, immunity, timing and fear.
Spleen.defined: You have a consistent intuition and a reliable sense of what is healthy and safe for you, in the moment. You often feel well even when others do not.
Spleen.open: You are very sensitive to health and to the moods and fears of others. You can be a great sensor of what is healthy around you.
Spleen.question: Am I holding on to something I should let go of?
Spleen.trap: Holding on to people, jobs and habits that are not good for you, because they feel familiar and safe. Being driven by fears that are not yours.
Spleen.wisdom: You become wise about health and wellbeing, and about what is genuinely safe.

SolarPlexus.does: Emotions, feelings, sensitivity and the emotional wave.
SolarPlexus.defined: You ride your own emotional wave, and your clarity comes with time. People feel your emotional field when you walk in.
SolarPlexus.open: You are deeply empathic. You feel other people's emotions, sometimes more strongly than they do. Not all of what you feel is yours.
SolarPlexus.question: Am I avoiding confrontation and truth?
SolarPlexus.trap: Avoiding confrontation and truth to keep the peace. Being a people pleaser. Taking on emotions as if they were your own.
SolarPlexus.wisdom: You become wise about emotions: you can feel the emotional health of a room, without being lost in it.

Sacral.does: Life force, work energy, sexuality and fertility.
Sacral.defined: You have sustainable life-force energy, renewed every day, as long as it goes into what you genuinely respond to.
Sacral.open: You are not built for nonstop, sustained work. You take in and amplify the Sacral energy of others, which can make you feel like you can keep going forever, until you crash.
Sacral.question: Do I know when enough is enough?
Sacral.trap: Not knowing when enough is enough. Overworking to keep up with Sacral types. Saying yes because you feel you should.
Sacral.wisdom: You become wise about energy: who has it, how it is being used, and when it is time to stop.

Root.defined: You handle pressure in your own steady rhythm, and you can use adrenaline as fuel.
Root.open: You take in and amplify the pressure around you. You feel the urge to hurry and to get things off your plate.
Root.question: Am I in a hurry to get things done so I can be free of the pressure?
Root.trap: Rushing to be free of pressure. Doing things just to make the pressure stop.
Root.wisdom: You become wise about stress, and you learn to tell the difference between real urgency and borrowed pressure.

1.name: Self-Expression
1.text: A drive to express yourself in your own original way. You are at your best when you stop trying to fit in and create from what is genuinely yours.

2.name: Direction
2.text: A quiet inner sense of direction, the driver who knows where things are heading. It works through receptivity, holding the direction rather than forcing it.

3.name: Ordering
3.text: The energy to bring order out of chaos. Beginnings feel messy for you because something new is trying to come through. Give it time to find its form.

4.name: Formulization
4.text: A mind that looks for answers and formulas. You love to explain how things work, and your answers are best held as possibilities until life tests them.

5.name: Fixed Rhythms
5.text: Fixed rhythms and natural timing. Routines, habits and the right pace keep you well, and you feel thrown when your rhythm is disrupted.

6.name: Friction
6.text: Emotional friction that regulates intimacy: who gets close and when. It decides through feeling, and it brings people together when the timing is right.

7.name: The Role of the Self
7.text: The role of the self in leading: a natural sense of how a group should move forward. Your leadership works best when it is recognised and asked for.

8.name: Contribution
8.text: Contributing something original. You want to make your unique mark and, by doing so, show others that being themselves is possible.

9.name: Focus
9.text: The power of focus on the details. You can concentrate on one thing deeply when it is the right thing, and you bring things to completion.

10.name: Behaviour of the Self
10.text: Behaviour of the self: the deep love of being yourself. You are here to act in line with who you are, and to show others what self-love looks like.

11.name: Ideas
11.text: A mind full of ideas and images. Not every idea is meant to be acted on. Many are simply for sharing and inspiring.

12.name: Caution
12.text: Caution in expression. You speak with real impact when the mood is right, and you know instinctively when to hold back.

13.name: The Listener
13.text: The listener. People tell you their secrets and their stories, and you hold the experiences of others. One day those stories become wisdom.

14.name: Power Skills
14.text: Power skills: the energy to fuel what you love, and the resources that follow when your energy goes the right way.

15.name: Extremes
15.text: Extremes and the love of humanity. Your rhythm swings between extremes, and you hold space for many different kinds of people.

16.name: Skills
16.text: Skills and enthusiasm, built through repetition. Practice is how your talent becomes mastery.

17.name: Opinions
17.text: Opinions about how things should be organised for the future. Your views are most welcome when someone has asked for them.

18.name: Correction
18.text: The urge to correct and improve what is not working. A critical eye that, used well, makes things better for everyone.

19.name: Wanting
19.text: Wanting and sensitivity to needs: food, shelter, belonging. You feel what people need to feel supported.

20.name: The Now
20.text: Living in the now. Your expression is present tense: you speak and act from what is happening in this moment.

21.name: The Hunter
21.text: The hunter or huntress. A need to control your own resources, space and territory, and to manage the material world well.

22.name: Openness
22.text: Openness and grace. Your emotional expression has a charm that opens people, when the mood is right.

23.name: Assimilation
23.text: Assimilation: turning unusual insights into something others can understand. Your gift is explaining the new in simple words.

24.name: Rationalization
24.text: Rationalisation: returning to the same thought until it makes sense. Insight arrives after many rounds of reflection.

25.name: The Spirit of the Self
25.text: The spirit of the self: universal love and innocence. A deep trust that survives life's tests.

26.name: The Egoist
26.text: The egoist: a gift for persuasion, sales and memory. You can make anything sound good, which is a responsibility as much as a talent.

27.name: Caring
27.text: Caring and nourishing. You look after others naturally. Remember that you are on the list of people to care for too.

28.name: The Game Player
28.text: The game player: searching for what makes life worth living, and willing to take risks for it.

29.name: Saying Yes
29.text: Perseverance: saying yes and then seeing it through. Commit only to what your gut truly responds to, because you will stick with it.

30.name: Feelings
30.text: Recognising feelings and the fire of desire. Strong longings that are meant to be felt fully, rather than all satisfied at once.

31.name: Influence
31.text: Influence and leadership voiced for the collective. People follow when you have been chosen to lead.

32.name: Continuity
32.text: Continuity: an instinct for what will last and what will fail. You sense the value of the past and the risk of change.

33.name: Privacy
33.text: Privacy and retreat. You need to withdraw to reflect, and then you share what you have learned with others.

34.name: Power
34.text: Pure power: the energy to be busy and independent. Strength that works best when it responds rather than pushes.

35.name: Change
35.text: Change and the hunger for new experiences. You collect experience, and your wisdom comes from having done it.

36.name: Crisis
36.text: Crisis and inexperience: emotional energy that pushes you into new experiences, with all the drama and growth that comes with them.

37.name: Friendship
37.text: Friendship and the family bond. You build community through warmth, loyalty and fair agreements.

38.name: The Fighter
38.text: The fighter: the stubborn energy to struggle for what gives your life meaning. Choose your battles well.

39.name: Provocation
39.text: Provocation: you stir something in people, often their spirit or their emotions, which can wake them up.

40.name: Aloneness
40.text: Aloneness: you work hard for your people, and then you genuinely need time alone to recover. Both are part of the bargain.

41.name: Contraction
41.text: Contraction and fantasy: the start of new experiences as dreams and desires. A source of imagination.

42.name: Growth
42.text: Growth and completion. You are built to finish cycles and to bring things to their natural end.

43.name: Insight
43.text: Insight: sudden inner knowing, sometimes hard to explain. It lands best when someone has asked for it.

44.name: Alertness
44.text: Alertness: an instinct for patterns from the past, and for talent in other people.

45.name: The Gatherer
45.text: The gatherer: a natural voice for managing resources and holding a group together. "I have" energy.

46.name: Determination of the Self
46.text: Determination of the self: love of the body, and success through being in the right place at the right time.

47.name: Realization
47.text: Realisation: making sense of the past, often through confusion first. Clarity arrives in its own time.

48.name: Depth
48.text: Depth: a deep well of talent and solutions, sometimes with a fear of not knowing enough. You know more than you think.

49.name: Principles
49.text: Principles: sensitive to what is fair, and willing to reject what no longer fits. Revolution through feeling.

50.name: Values
50.text: Values: the guardian of what is right for the community. You hold values that keep people safe.

51.name: Shock
51.text: Shock: the courage to initiate through surprise and competition. You wake people up, and you recover from shocks with resilience.

52.name: Stillness
52.text: Stillness: the ability to sit still and concentrate. Restlessness turns into focus when you are engaged in the right thing.

53.name: Beginnings
53.text: Beginnings: the pressure to start new cycles of development. Starting is your gift. Finishing may belong to others.

54.name: Ambition
54.text: Ambition: drive to rise, materially and spiritually, and the energy to be noticed by the people who can help.

55.name: Spirit
55.text: Spirit: deep emotional moods, and an abundance that comes from the spirit, not from the bank account.

56.name: Stimulation
56.text: Stimulation: the storyteller. You turn ideas and experiences into stories that move and teach.

57.name: Intuitive Clarity
57.text: Intuitive clarity: an acute inner ear. You hear what is right in the moment, and your intuition sharpens with trust.

58.name: Vitality
58.text: Vitality: joy and the urge to improve things. Energy that comes alive when there is something to make better.

59.name: Sexuality
59.text: Sexuality and intimacy: breaking down barriers to create closeness, in love and in work.

60.name: Acceptance
60.text: Acceptance: accepting limitation, and finding the room within it for something new to emerge.

61.name: Inner Truth
61.text: Mystery: the pressure to know the unknowable, and to find your inner truth.

62.name: Details
62.text: Details: naming, organising and stating the facts. You make complex things precise and understandable.

63.name: Doubt
63.text: Doubt: healthy questioning that tests whether something is logical and sound.

64.name: Confusion
64.text: Confusion: a mind full of images from the past, resolving into clarity with time. Confusion is the step before understanding.

1.name: Investigator
1.text: Line 1 lives this through study and solid foundations: you need to understand it deeply to feel secure.

2.name: Hermit
2.text: Line 2 lives this naturally, without trying: it is a gift others notice, and it comes out best when you are called.

3.name: Martyr
3.text: Line 3 lives this through trial and error: you learn it by bumping into what does not work.

4.name: Opportunist
4.text: Line 4 lives this through your people: it spreads through your friendships and network.

5.name: Heretic
5.text: Line 5 lives this as the practical answer others look to you for: it shapes your reputation.

6.name: Role Model
6.text: Line 6 lives this over a long arc: experimenting, stepping back, then embodying it as an example.

Sun.name: Sun
Sun.text: The Sun is the core of your design, about 70% of the imprint: the theme you radiate.

Earth.name: Earth
Earth.text: The Earth is what grounds you and brings you back into balance.

North Node.name: North Node
North Node.text: The North Node is read as the direction and environment that matter more from around mid-life on.

South Node.name: South Node
South Node.text: The South Node is read as the direction and environment that shaped your earlier life.

Moon.name: Moon
Moon.text: The Moon is read as your driving force: what moves you.

Mercury.name: Mercury
Mercury.text: Mercury is read as communication: what you are here to say.

Venus.name: Venus
Venus.text: Venus is read as values: what feels right and wrong to you.

Mars.name: Mars
Mars.text: Mars is read as where you are immature at first and grow up over time.

Jupiter.name: Jupiter
Jupiter.text: Jupiter is read as your inner law: where protection and expansion come from when you honour it.

Saturn.name: Saturn
Saturn.text: Saturn is read as discipline and consequence: where you learn the hard way and grow strong.

Uranus.name: Uranus
Uranus.text: Uranus is read as the unusual: where you are unconventional.

Neptune.name: Neptune
Neptune.text: Neptune is read as the veiled: where things are subtle, spiritual or hard to see clearly.

Pluto.name: Pluto
Pluto.text: Pluto is read as truth and deep transformation: where you change at the root.

1-8.name: Inspiration
1-8.text: A creative role model. You are here to express something original and, simply by doing it your way, inspire others to find their own.

2-14.name: The Beat
2-14.text: You carry the keys to direction and resources. When your energy follows what you love, the resources tend to follow.

3-60.name: Mutation
3-60.text: Energy that comes in pulses. Change arrives in its own time, often after long periods where nothing seems to move.

4-63.name: Logic
4-63.text: A mind built to doubt, test and find the formula. You see the patterns and ask whether they hold.

5-15.name: Rhythm
5-15.text: You are in tune with natural flow and timing. Your rhythms keep you well, and they shape the people around you.

6-59.name: Intimacy
6-59.text: You can break through barriers and create closeness, whether that leads to a relationship, a family or creative work.

7-31.name: The Alpha
7-31.text: Natural leadership. When people recognise and invite you, your voice can shape a group’s direction.

9-52.name: Concentration
9-52.text: The power to focus deeply and stay with one thing for a long time.

10-20.name: Awakening
10-20.text: You live what you believe, in the moment, and become an example of self-love in action.

10-34.name: Exploration
10-34.text: Following your own convictions with real energy, wherever they lead you.

10-57.name: Perfected Form
10-57.text: An intuitive instinct for survival and for doing things beautifully and well.

11-56.name: Curiosity
11-56.text: A seeker and storyteller. You gather ideas and experiences and turn them into stories that teach and stimulate others.

12-22.name: Openness
12-22.text: A social, emotional voice. When the mood is right, your words can move people deeply.

13-33.name: The Prodigal
13-33.text: A witness. You listen, remember, step back to reflect, and later share the wisdom of what you have seen.

16-48.name: The Wavelength
16-48.text: Talent deepened through repetition. Practice turns your depth into mastery.

17-62.name: Acceptance
17-62.text: An organiser of details into opinions and structures that others can understand.

18-58.name: Judgment
18-58.text: A joyful drive to correct and improve whatever does not work.

19-49.name: Synthesis
19-49.text: Deep sensitivity to needs and principles, and to who belongs together.

20-34.name: Charisma
20-34.text: Constant busyness and the power to act in the moment. When you respond, you are unstoppable.

20-57.name: The Brainwave
20-57.text: Intuition spoken in the moment. You often say the right thing before you know why.

21-45.name: Money
21-45.text: Material mastery and the drive to manage resources for yourself and your tribe.

23-43.name: Structuring
23-43.text: Individual genius. Unique insights you are here to explain, in your own words and at the right time.

24-61.name: Awareness
24-61.text: A mind that searches the mysteries and returns again and again until it knows.

25-51.name: Initiation
25-51.text: The courage to leap into the unknown and initiate yourself and others.

26-44.name: Surrender
26-44.text: A natural talent for transmission: sales, persuasion and passing on what was learned.

27-50.name: Preservation
27-50.text: Caring and values. You take responsibility for the wellbeing of others.

28-38.name: Struggle
28-38.text: The stubborn will to find purpose. You fight for what makes life meaningful.

29-46.name: Discovery
29-46.text: Total commitment to an experience. You discover the meaning by going all the way through it.

30-41.name: Recognition
30-41.text: Deep feeling and imagination, longing for new experiences.

32-54.name: Transformation
32-54.text: Ambition guided by an instinct for what will last.

34-57.name: Power
34-57.text: Intuitive power in the moment, a gift for survival.

35-36.name: Transitoriness
35-36.text: A hunger for experience, emotions included, out of which comes wisdom.

37-40.name: Community
37-40.text: The glue of family and community: loyalty, support and a fair bargain.

39-55.name: Emoting
39-55.text: Moody, creative, emotional spirit. You stir feelings in others.

42-53.name: Maturation
42-53.text: Starting and finishing cycles. You grow through each experience.

47-64.name: Abstraction
47-64.text: A mind that makes sense of the past through images, until clarity arrives.
